items.definition:
the process of coming into being or becoming prominent
The emergence of new technologies has changed our lives.

the ability to withstand hardship or stress
Running a marathon requires great endurance.

the action of evacuating a person or a place
The evacuation of the building was ordered due to the fire.

a long, narrow cut or depression
The record needle followed the groove.

a thin board or slab on which an artist lays and mixes colors
The artist mixed the paints on her palette.

lung inflammation caused by bacterial or viral infection
He was diagnosed with pneumonia and needed to rest.

an animal that hunts others
Lions are apex predators in their ecosystem.

the act of repairing and improving something
The old house is undergoing a major renovation.

a title for a member of the clergy
The Reverend Smith delivered a powerful sermon.

a sudden attack of illness; the act of taking something
The patient suffered a sudden seizure.

a male animal used for breeding; a small knob or projection
The horse was a prize-winning stud.

the speed of a piece of music or activity
The band played the song at a fast tempo.

a turbocharger
The car has a powerful turbo engine.

the rate of change of velocity
The car showed impressive acceleration from 0 to 60 mph.

a respiratory condition marked by spasms in the bronchi of the lungs
He carries an inhaler because he suffers from asthma.

a length of something wound into a spiral or series of rings
The electrical wire was neatly wound into a coil.

love, loyalty, or enthusiasm for a person or activity
Her devotion to her family was evident in everything she did.

a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives
He faced a difficult dilemma: either miss the meeting or cancel his vacation.

loss of reputation or respect as the result of a dishonorable action
His actions brought disgrace upon his family.

the fact or state of belonging to a social group that has a common national or cultural tradition
The survey asked about the participant's ethnicity.

greed
His greed led him to make bad decisions.

headquarters
The company's HQ is located in New York.

knockout
The boxer won by a KO in the third round.

millionaire
He became a millionaire by investing wisely.

pact, agreement
They relentlessly pursued a peace pact.

patron, supporter
The museum thanked its generous patrons.

revolt, rebellion
The peasants staged a revolt against the king.

a place regarded as holy
They visited the ancient shrine.

a person who shoots from a hidden position
The sniper aimed carefully at the target.

a feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or other misfortune
Her heart was filled with sorrow after the news.

the action of bringing something to an end
The termination of the contract was unexpected.

a mythical creature or someone who posts inflammatory messages online
Don't feed the internet troll.

a written guarantee, issued to the purchaser of an article by its manufacturer, promising to repair or replace it if necessary within a specified period
The car comes with a three-year warranty.

the passage by which air reaches a person's lungs; a route for aircraft
The paramedic checked the patient's airway.

an object made by a human being, typically an item of cultural or historical interest
Archaeologists discovered ancient artifacts at the site.

reddish-brown color
Her long, auburn hair cascaded down her back.

the act of waking up or becoming aware
The trip was an awakening to new cultures.

a fatty substance found in the body
Eating healthy can help manage your cholesterol levels.

a hostile or argumentative meeting or situation
He avoided a direct confrontation with his boss.

a person who gives or provides something
She was a key contributor to the project.

something worn to conceal one's identity
He wore a clever disguise to the party.

the act of sending someone away or ending their employment
Her dismissal from the company was unexpected.

the ability to understand and share the feelings of another
Showing empathy is crucial for good communication.

a sudden strong urge or desire to act
She bought the shoes on impulse.

the state of being seriously mentally ill; extreme foolishness
The stress drove him to the brink of insanity.

A university teacher.
The lecturer explained the complex theory clearly.

Intense sexual desire or craving.
His eyes showed a clear lust for power.

A short sentence or phrase chosen as encapsulating the beliefs or ideals of an individual, family, or institution.
"Never give up" is a good motto to live by.

A person engaged or learned in philosophy.
Aristotle was a famous Greek philosopher.

A minute area of illumination on a display screen, one of many from which an image is composed.
The image was blurry because it had too few pixels.

An estate on which crops such as coffee, sugar, or tobacco are cultivated by resident labor.
The old plantation house was surrounded by cotton fields.

An act of becoming aware of something.
The sudden realization of her mistake made her blush.

A short and striking or memorable phrase used in advertising or politics.
The company's new slogan is "Think Different."

The desire to do something, especially something wrong or unwise.
She resisted the temptation to eat the whole cake.

a task or enterprise
Building the bridge was a massive undertaking.

a comparison between two things
He drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.

a person who provides a commentary
The sports commentator described the game live.

the act of continuing or being continued
The continuation of the project depends on funding.

a group of vehicles or ships traveling together
A convoy of trucks delivered the supplies.

a person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor
He is a direct descendant of the founder of the city.

a device designed to discover the presence of something
The smoke detector started beeping loudly.

an official or authoritative instruction
The new directive came from the CEO.

disturbance or problems interrupting an event, activity, or process
The strike caused widespread disruption to travel.

the resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another
There was a lot of friction between the two departments.
